standing_instruction: Always generate unfinished product photos from the end of the authorized list toward the start. Select highest product IDs first for every current and future authorized queue; preserve complete products and valid saved views.
scope_rule: Ordering preference does not broaden the authorized product range or imply daily recurrence.
parallel_dispatch_rule: Dispatch each next available product in descending ID order. Completion order can vary with parallel calls. Review saved partials when their ID is reached; never regenerate valid complete products.
